core_definition: Canonical ownership/provenance/temporal/identity contracts plus small deterministic helpers; excludes Thread, X-Ray, Source Anomaly, Half-Life and public/product projections.

cases.reason: The case asks about the law's threshold/procedure abstractly and supplies no concrete model-specific compute observation. Creating an Authoritative Metric Observation would fabricate evidence. Core adds value by refusing that promotion, not by serializing the hypothetical.

Provenance can preserve the private Airbus document and public EASA AD separately, but current Core has no narrow owner for a private technical document incorporated/referenced by a public mandate. Recognized External Determination is not applicable because the ALS is technical content, not a determination.
cases.guardrail: Do not add a schema during the value gate merely to improve Core's score.

cases.reason: Judicial Holding v0.1 cleanly represents the Privacy Shield INVALIDITY holding. It cannot honestly represent the Court's separate affirmative validity result for Decision 2010/87 because VALIDITY is not an allowed holding type. Relabelling it INTERPRETATION would distort the holding.
Two scoped APPLICATION START assertions allow deterministic repeated queries: non-laptop categories active on 2025-01-01, laptops inactive until 2026-04-28.
cases.guardrail: For one question, encoding costs more than careful reading.

cases.reason: Language-Scoped Mutation v0.1 preserves the Dutch-only correction event, before/after text, publication date and NO_ASSERTION semantics for non-listed languages. Combined with source/provenance perspective, the historical wording no longer has to be rediscovered manually.
cases.value: Reproducible historical source-state reconstruction across later sessions/queries.

core_summary.important_negative: The value gate itself found a Core gap in Judicial Holding v0.1. This is evidence against treating the current ontology as the project contribution.
